Definition: from G4012 and G2904; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):--+ come by.
BiblicalUsage: Perikrates means strong all around, a master of the situation — here, to come by something with difficulty. Running under the island of Clauda, the sailors had much work to come by the boat in the storm.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that even the crew's hard-won boat was God's provision: they came by it with much work, and it carried them through.
